summary: Virax Biolabs filed a Form 6-K (US-equivalent current report on Form 8-K) disclosing the elimination of its standalone Chief Operating Officer role as part of a senior-management restructuring to cut operating expenditure and prioritize ViraxImmune development. Dr. Nigel McCracken, COO, was made redundant, began paid garden leave October 5, 2026, and terminates December 23, 2026, remaining a board director; he receives a statutory redundancy payment of £3,379.50 plus pay in lieu of his three-month notice. The board appointed Clement Monteil Acting Chief Scientific Officer for an initial six-month term. Watch integration risk and any further executive turnover.
